Char Siu Rice.note: Pork. Soy sauce = soy + gluten; sesame oil in the glaze; honey.

Siu Yuk Rice.note: Pork belly. Shaoxing wine rub = sulphites + gluten, not halal. English mustard on the side = mustard.

Roast Duck Rice.note: Fermented bean paste = soy + gluten. Rose wine (mei kuei lu, sorghum spirit) = not halal; adds no allergen by the rules (like kaoliang). Plum sauce adds nothing.

Soy Sauce Chicken Rice.note: No pork, but Shaoxing wine in the master stock = sulphites + gluten, not halal. Soy sauce = soy + gluten.

Double Roast Rice.note: Char siu (soy, sesame oil) + siu yuk (Shaoxing wine) + English mustard. Pork.

Half Roast Duck.note: As Roast Duck Rice: fermented bean paste = soy + gluten; rose wine = not halal.

Roast Meat Platter.note: Char siu, siu yuk and roast duck combined, plus English mustard. Pork and wine.

Wonton Noodles.note: Egg noodles and wonton wrappers = gluten + egg; soy sauce; prawn wontons = crustaceans; char siu slices carry the sesame-oil glaze. Pork lard. Pickled green chillies = mild.

Spicy Wonton in Chilli Oil.note: Wheat-and-egg wrappers; prawns; soy sauce and black vinegar (wheat); sesame seeds. Pork. Very spicy.

Shui Gao Noodle Soup.note: Egg noodles and wheat dumpling wrappers; prawn filling; dried flounder broth = fish. Pork. No soy sauce stated.

Beef Brisket Hor Fun.note: Rice noodles, but chu hou paste (fermented soybean + wheat flour + sesame paste) = soy + gluten + sesame, oyster sauce (rule g: molluscs + gluten) and Shaoxing wine (sulphites, not halal). Dried chillies, described as spicy.

Mushroom Lo Mein.note: Merchant (vegetarian) tag. Egg noodles = gluten + egg, so not vegan. Light soy sauce = soy + gluten; sesame oil. Wood ear is a fungus.

Century Egg Pork Congee.note: Century egg (duck egg) = egg; yau char kwai = wheat dough = gluten. Pork.

Fish Slice Congee.note: Fish-bone stock and grouper = fish. No meat or alcohol, so halal; pescatarian-friendly. Fried shallots and white pepper are not spicy.

Plain Congee.note: Sounds plain but is simmered with pork bones (not vegetarian, not halal) and dried scallops (molluscs); yau char kwai = gluten.

Kai Lan Oyster Sauce.note: Oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (rule g), not vegetarian.

Garlic Kai Lan.note: Stated no oyster sauce; merchant (vegan) tag.

Egg Tofu with Mushrooms.note: Japanese egg tofu = egg + soy; oyster sauce gravy = molluscs + gluten, so not vegetarian.

Dang Gui Black Chicken Soup.note: Shaoxing wine = sulphites + gluten, not halal. Chicken.

Lotus Root Peanut Soup.note: Sounds vegetable-based but has pork ribs and dried octopus (molluscs); raw peanuts.

Herbal Jelly.note: Stated made without turtle shell; served with honey, so vegetarian but not vegan.

Mango Sago Pomelo.note: Evaporated milk = milk; coconut milk is not milk.

Egg Tart.note: Egg custard; butter pastry = milk + gluten. Butter (not lard) stated.

Black Sesame Paste.note: Black sesame; stated no dairy; merchant (vegan) tag.

Guinness Stout.note: Beer (barley malt) = gluten, not halal. Vegan (no isinglass since 2018).
